name: 75/34 M43
description: The Semovente da 75/34 M43 was an Italian self-propelled gun. By the end of World War II, half of Italy was under the control of the Wehrmacht. Production facilities for the 75/46 M43 and licensed copies of the 75-mm KwK 40 gun were located in the German-occupied zone. However, due to Allied bombing, producing guns became nearly impossible. As a result, the Germans ordered the continuation of producing self-propelled guns using whatever was available in stock, which turned out to be Italian 75/34 Mod. S.F. guns. Additionally, the frontal armor of the self-propelled gun was reinforced during production. A total of 29 vehicles were built and served the Wehrmacht until the end of the war. The 75/34 M43 was introduced in Update 1.85 "Supersonic" . It is a small vehicle with good frontal armor and a gun capable of firing HEAT rounds. However, the vehicle’s compact design makes it fragile, and its shell penetration may be insufficient.
